steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX functionality required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet can be configured.
Add the specified product and quantity.
Confirm the requested product was added.
Confirm the product's default variant is populated.
Confirm the requested quantity.
Set the requested delivery location.
Verify the delivery location was selected.
Add one QA test vendor for publishing.
Open the Schedule Event drawer.
Choose custom duration instead of a preset.
Enter the two-hour duration amount.
Set the custom duration unit to hours.
Verify the custom duration amount is retained.
Verify the duration unit is hours.
Commit the custom schedule.
Publish the configured RFQ event.
Confirm publication reached a real project page.
Confirm no publication or schedule error is shown.
